import json, subprocess, sys, tempfile, os, filecmp
SUB="/workspace/submission/main.py"
pub="/workspace/public"
cfg=open(pub+"/config.json","rb").read()
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-I",SUB,"compile"],input=cfg,stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
prog=json.loads(p.stdout)
d=tempfile.mkdtemp(); path=os.path.join(d,"program.json")
open(path,"w").write(json.dumps(prog))   # exactly like sanity.py does
reqs=open(pub+"/requests.jsonl").read()
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-I",SUB,"stream",path],input=reqs.encode(),stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
got=r.stdout.decode().splitlines()
exp=open(pub+"/expected.jsonl").read().splitlines()
print("byte-identical to expected:", got==exp, "rc", r.returncode)
for g,e in zip(got,exp):
    if g!=e: print("  got",g,"\n  exp",e)
print(r.stdout.decode())
EOF
